# Diana Barry & Gilbert Blythe

- [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) — Friend of — [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) — tried to act as a peacemaker between him and Anne · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), [v3 ch.People P0](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0000)</sub>
- [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) — Comrade of — [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) — fellow officer and member of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society · since v2  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school, discussing the local students and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's return. During afternoon classes, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) teases [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by pulling her braid and calling her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard, and she refuses to accept Gilbert's apology after school.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> After Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) publicly punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for being late by forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), she refuses to ever return to his school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cool off at home for a while. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is overcome with laughter when she finds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping over an imagined future scenario where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gets married and leaves her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

A Tempest in the School Teapot P96](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0096)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a dramatic goodbye after Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forbids [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where she is warmly welcomed by her classmates, exchanges secret notes with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and enters a fierce academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an advanced class to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, which [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) should join. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eagerly accepts the opportunity to study to become a teacher. When the class begins, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) faces intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and realizes she has secretly forgiven him.
>

> After finishing school and taking her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) anxiously awaits the results at home. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes over to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the newspaper to announce that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the entire [Island](../codex/places.md#island), bringing great joy and pride to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress in her east gable room before driving to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for a benefit concert with [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md). Despite an initial wave of severe stage fright upon seeing the sophisticated crowd and high-caliber performers, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sees [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the audience and finds the resolve to deliver a triumphant recitation, earning an encore and praise from the guests.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adjusts to life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), making new friends while maintaining her dedicated academic focus alongside her classmates. As examination time approaches, the students prepare for the upcoming tests, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflecting philosophically on her efforts and future.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wins the Avery Scholarship while [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal. After celebrating commencement with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), re-engaging with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), noticing Matthew's failing health, and sharing a tender, memorable evening walk with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue canvassing [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for subscriptions, encountering peculiar neighbors like the hyper-neat Mrs. Theodore White and receiving mixed results. Learning that [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) just had a new baby boy, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) strategically visits him while he is overjoyed, securing a generous five-dollar donation. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a contribution, but he flatly refuses.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) converses with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) regarding Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and the ongoing hall improvement project. Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) paints the hall a shocking bright blue due to a mix-up with the paint numbers, news spreads across town. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and Oliver gather with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in shared dismay over the disaster.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses town matters with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before returning home to learn from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that the twins must stay until fall. After dealing with Davy's jam-stealing and catechism confusions, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting where news breaks about [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) renting his fences for advertisements. The society sends a committee to reason with Judson, but he refuses to change his plans.
>

> Following the broken platter incident, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) goes home and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns with a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) stating that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) cannot visit. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's tendency to experience emotional highs and lows, plan how to reimburse [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), and chat about local gossip regarding Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P64](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0064), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P65](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0065), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P68](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0068)_

> As wedding preparations for Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) continue, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) express their excitement about moving to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston). Meanwhile, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on romance with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and later stumbles upon [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) sharing an intimate moment. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) later visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide her engagement to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to ponder her own future dreams of love.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help prepare for Miss Lavendar's wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before the intimate ceremony takes place in the garden as the sun breaks through the clouds. After seeing the newly married couple off at the station, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) return to tidy up the house, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later shares a quiet, subtly meaningful moment with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before they leave.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) chat about growing up and upcoming changes as they rest in the orchard. After getting a letter from [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) on the bridge, but she gets flustered and cuts the moment short when he touches her hand. Returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she comforts [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) and talks with him before spending a quiet moment dreaming by the brook.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) amidst tearful goodbyes and travels by train and boat to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Charlie. Upon arriving, she is greeted by [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), who takes her to their new boardinghouse while chatting gaily to lift her homesick spirits.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and her cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md). Before leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) faces mixed reviews about her published story and adopts a stray cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), whom they fail to chloroform. Eventually, [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives to chaperon the household with a relaxed attitude toward their independence.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) prepare for her wedding to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), reflecting on their lifelong friendship. After the ceremony, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) accompanies [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back toward [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and they take a stroll through Lovers' Lane, where they converse about their summer plans and changing lives.
